backendConfigEditor.fieldFieldInline_message_modelContextTok: Model context window (in tokens): the Agent uses it to decide when to compact the context and as the denominator of the usage indicator. Leave it empty to use {{DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW}}; values such as 200000 or 128k work too. The Agent only uses the model and window of the first token.
backendConfigEditor.field_message_randomFallbackCountCount: random rotates randomly; fallback uses the first entry and switches to the next one on error
backendConfigEditor.field_message_defaultSentenceTranslation: On by default. When enabled, translated sentences appear in “Recent translations” as soon as they are produced, and the small light in the file progress tells thinking from translating and pulses with the output speed. When disabled, results appear only after the whole batch comes back, and the light just shows “Requesting”. Turn it off only when the endpoint or relay does not support streaming.
backendConfigEditor.field_message_0Job: 0 means no limit; this limit is shared globally across jobs

gettingStarted.description_description_projectProjectDi: In the project’s “Project dictionary”, click “Generate GPT dictionary with AI”: GenDic reads the source text, extracts personal names, place names and proper nouns, and fixes their translations so terminology stays consistent during the real translation (you can skip it, but names tend to drift).
gettingStarted.description_description_projectStartTran: Start the translation from the project’s “Start translation” page, then pick up the translation from the gt_output folder once it finishes.
